run_flowise_query: run a FlowiseAI flow by calling pipe with a flow name and user query
stream_flowise_response: stream responses from a FlowiseAI flow using stream_retrieve with flow_id and query
build_flowise_pipeline: build a FlowiseAI pipeline with enabled flows, API key, base URL, and rate limit valves
review_flowise_flow_details: review flowise flow details by fetching flow metadata via get_flow_details with a flow_id
parse_flowise_user_input: parse a user message into flow name and query using parse_user_input with colon-separated format
